scene makotoiobath1
Not far at all from where we just were, different events were unfolding! Joyous events! The kind that make you wish you could be a part of them when there’s somewhere else you need to be!
But that didn’t mean everyone present was happy about it.
: Fucking...slow down, Miku! Why are you running?! You’re going to hurt yourself!
scene makotoiobath2
: Impossible! Miku Maruyama is immune to pain! And she is running because she can! Because she must! And because that friggin’ hot spring is callin’ my name!
scene makotoiobath3
: Can you at least put a towel on so you’re not running around completely naked then?
: Why? We’re just gonna be takin’ em off again in ten seconds, ain’t we? Makes way more sense to just let it all hang out, I think! Or...let nothin’ hang out in the case of me and Io.
: I believe it’s less a matter of practicality and more one of sheer modesty, Miku. It’s sort of just an unwritten rule to stop running around without clothes on once you make it into high school.
: I think it’s kind of frowned upon before that too, but I’m not about to argue if what Makoto’s saying convinces you to be less, uhh...out there.
scene makotoiobath4
: It doesn’t!
scene makotoiobath5
: MARUYAMA SECRET TECHNIQUE — CANNONBALL!
: At least give it a more interesting name!
: Miku! Didn’t you read the signs?! Don’t even think about jumping into that water! You’ll regret it! Seriously!
: Too late, Makoto! I’m-
scene makotoiobath6
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH! WHY’S IT SO FRIGGIN’ LOUD?!?!?!!?!
: See? I told you you’d regret. There were signs all over the place saying to not jump into the hot spring at the risk of it exploding.
: WHY’S THAT EVEN A THING?!?!?!?! THIS WOULD’A TOTALLY CAUSED ME AN EPISODE LIKE FIFTY UPDATES AGO!!!
: Exploding water...great. Let’s hope my aunt never hears about this. Sounds hard to clean.
scene makotoiobath7
: Oh, right. Your family runs the local bathhouse, don’t they?
: It’s just my aunt and me. Not my family. And also, don’t talk to me. I am here only because Uta is hanging out with Sensei’s niece right now and I thought it was just going to be Miku and me.
: I don’t intend to try and bond with you if that’s what you’re worried about. I just figured we might find some common ground as I’ve also been dragged into running my family’s business.
: With all due respect, which is basically none, I have heard about what your family’s business is. And I would much prefer it if you didn’t try to relate it to my family’s legitimate one.
scene makotoiobath8
: I understand the sentiment. But if you really think about it, isn’t your place of work even more adult-oriented than mine? At least people have to wear clothes inside of my store.
scene makotoiobath9
: Okay. So both of our workplaces suck. Do you really want that to be the launching point for trying and failing at getting to know me, though?
: Not...really. I just know that you’re not exactly fond of things like this.
: So it’s less me getting to know you and more trying to make myself seem relatable and familiar so you’re not uncomfortable with me being here as well.
: Then just...don’t talk to me or look at me. In fact, stay away entirely. Just...do the complete opposite of everything Miku did and...maybe I won’t want you to die.
: You don’t want Miku to die though, do you?
: No. But I imagine her methods merely worked because I can convince myself she’s a boy if I squint my eyes hard enough. I’d have hated her if she was anyone else.
: Then why do you like Uta so much? She’s essentially as girly as they come.
scene makotoiobath10
: It’s complicated, okay?! Just mind your own fucking business!
scene makotoiobath11
: Miku! Close your eyes. I’m taking my towel off now.
: Whaaaat?! We ain’t gonna compare boobs or somethin’?! Ain’t that how these hot springs scenes work?!
: Wow. She really is closed off, isn’t she?
scene black
Makoto Miyamura wasn’t sure what to do. Especially since word had in fact gotten around that Io had been through something earlier in life.
No one ever brought it up — but it wasn’t really out of respect for her. It was out of respect for Uta.
And pity of course. Mainly pity. And that nostalgic brand of unease you get from certain bouts of morbid curiosity.
Such curiosities had overtaken Makoto lately, though. And it was as if everywhere she looked, there was a part of the world she never noticed when it only moved in one direction.
That was equal parts fascinating and terrifying. But was there really anything to fear at all when this life was practically permanent?
scene makotoiobath12
Terror as a concept had become little more than a pothole on the road that is life itself. Something that makes you go “ah” for a split second, then fades away almost immediately.
There’s no constant, lingering dread anymore. Just the occasional thought of, “Hey — if I die, won’t I just wake up somewhen else?” And that blended quite smoothly with her new way of life.
But it also compelled her to want to make the best of this one.
So despite how frequently she told herself that life now was just a series of orgasms and cups of coffee and sleeping through alarms, it was still a puzzle.
And Makoto liked puzzles.
Not just solving them either. She enjoyed those feelings of confusion and helplessness that many others cower before or fall victim to. But she had already endured her own brand of that.
So she scorned the world for killing her father but, at the same time, she felt thankful.
Because there was nothing left to fear anymore.
AT LEAST FOR NOW.
: Dang, Makoto. I ain’t seen you look this relaxed and satisfied since the last time you came back from Sensei’s house.
: Why did you have to go and ruin my moment of inner-peace like that, Miku?
scene makotoiobath13
: What’s wrong with bringin’ up the one thread tyin’ the three of us together?! This is a hot springs scene! If we ain’t gonna touch each other’s boobs, we’ve at least gotta bring up boys!
: That doesn’t give us much leeway as three heterosexuals then, does it?
scene makotoiobath14
: You’re right. We better go find the one or two other girls in our class that ain’t been converted yet and drag ‘em in here or we’ll run outta topics to discuss at this rate.
: Io — you’ve got a list, don’t you? I ain’t even sure where to start.
: Of straight people? No. The only list I have is the love journal with Uta, and I’m not sure if I can publicly divulge the rankings of that without her present.
scene makotoiobath15
: Can you at least say which one of us is in the lead?
: I probably can. I just won’t because I don’t personally agree with the answer and am formally protesting the current results.
: I don’t even wanna know the ranking. It’s just gonna be friggin’ Ami and Ayane at the top. Rest of us are basically chop suey and gotta work harder.
: Does Io even like Sensei like that, though?
scene makotoiobath16
: You askin’ me or her? Io ain’t really told me much about that. We just talk about sports.
: Io doesn’t want me to talk to her, so I’m just throwing the question out into the ether and hoping someone answers it.
: I like him romantically. Just my reasons for it probably aren’t the same as yours.
: Well, there ya have it. Straight from the horse’s balls.
scene makotoiobath17
: Oh! Touka! She’s straight! Horse balls made me think’a her! How many we got left?
: Makoto, make a worksheet or somethin’. We’ve gotta get to the bottom of this to figure out who to invite to our straight girls hot spring club.
: Futaba’s banned, though. I ain’t allowed near her boobs anymore.
: With respect to Io, we should probably stop bringing up boobs.
scene makotoiobath18
: Thank you.
: I understand. Nobody understands more than me...
: Yeah, I find that very hard to believe as you likely don’t understand at all.
scene makotoiobath19
: That don’t mean boys are banned though, right? Cause you still ain’t even told me what happened on your date with Sensei!
: And as a girl who wants to go on dates with Sensei myself, I feel like I’ve gotta absorb as many tips as I possibly can.
: I did tell you about what happened on the date, though. You just kept telling me I was making stuff up.
: Well, yeah! Cause you kept talkin' about a giant hole! And the only giant hole around here's the one between Kirin's legs.
: First, ew. Second, the hole is real.
scene makotoiobath20
: I still wanna hear more about what happened apart from the hole, though!
: Was it all romantic?! You guys kiss?! Or did ya just watch baseball and eat chips or somethin’? Sounds like an Io kinda date, right?
: It would be if Sensei actually liked baseball. The two of us just went to the convenience store and then walked around for a little bit after we met up.
scene makotoiobath21
: ...And then encountered a giant hole that led to an endless pit of nothingness in the middle of a sewer. Kind of hard to pivot away from a development like that.
: Damn, Io. You're so persistent about this that I'm startin' to actually believe you.
: I'm honestly surprised you don't already. You believed me when I told you leather was made from boiling milk.
: Wait. You tellin' me it ain't?
: I know you want me addressing you as little as possible, but I can’t help myself now. Question one — why were you in a sewer? And question two — “endless pit of nothingness?????”
scene makotoiobath22
: It was so weird! Like, I’ve been in those tunnels a million times before and had never seen that even once. It’s like it just showed up out of nowhere.
: Okay. Say this hole is real. The heck were you guys even doin’ down there?
: Exploring, obviously! What better spot for a date than an underground adventure?! Just, the place I was specifically trying to take him to, like...wasn’t even there anymore.
: And I know it sounds crazy, but it’s like the tunnels changed! Which makes me think it’s either a construction thing or a result of the sinkhole that stole my school. And my pencil case.
: I’m still investigating right now. Uta and I are gonna try and draw a map that-
: Okay, screw it! The hole is real!
: You’ve gotta let me get in on this too! I promise I won’t tell anybody! Scout’s honor! Oh! And Makoto too! We can all go together!
: I...will have to bring this up with the tunnel council. Which is just Uta and me. But even then, her long-standing rivalry with Uta in the Dorm Wars may lead to unnecessary competition that-
scene makotoiobath23
: Actually, you guys can do all of that without me. I don’t really have much interest in exploring a sewer right now.
: Whaaaat?! But it’s a cool sewer! With a big and probably real hole!
: It’s way bigger than just a hole, Miku. It’s like...unbelievable. I threw a rock down there and couldn’t even hear it hit the bottom!
: Seriously?! I want to throw rocks into the abyss too! You’ve gotta take me!
: Hey, I’m gonna get out a little early. No need to follow after me.
scene black
: Hm? Already? But you seemed so relaxed a few minutes ago. And this is our vacation. Don’t you wanna hang out a little while longer?
: Yeah, it was great. And maybe I’ll get back in later. I just need to go make a quick phone call. Sorry.
: Aww, man...now our straight girls club is only two people.
: I despise saying this, but that makes our club sound very not straight.
scene makotoiobath24
: ...Come on.
: Pick up...
: Uhh...hello? Mako-
: Why didn’t you tell me about Io’s giant hole?
scene makotoiobath25
: Because unlike you, I don’t body-shame. It’s 2020, Makoto. The size of someone’s hole does not change who they really are on the inside.
if iosex == True:
: Also, it wasn’t big at all. It's actually very nice if you can look past all of the trauma.
scene makotoiobath26
: No, you idiot! The hole you two encountered on your date in a sewer! You didn’t think that was weird and relevant to our freaky apocalyptic universe?!
: Oh...That hole.
: Sorry. My mind has been kind of elsewhere all day.
scene makotoiobath27
: When isn’t it? You should have told me the moment you found something like that. It could give us some sort of hint about all of this.
: Massive abysses like that don’t just appear overnight and-
scene makotoiobath28
: Are you having sex right now?
scene makotoiobath29
: Uhh...
: No?
: Ngh...aah...[norikomaster]! Who...is that?! Are they...coming to join us too?!
scene makotoiobath30
: It’s Makoto. Do you want to talk to her?
: Haaah! Ngaaah! Okay! Pass it...here...[norikomaster]!
scene makotoiobath31
: Noriko wants to talk to you. Here.
: Well, I don’t want to talk to her! Not while you’re-
: Aaah! H...Nghh...Hi...Makoto! How are...ngh...you....aaaah! How are you...doing?!
scene makotoiobath32
: ..................Great! Thanks so much for asking.
: Can you put Sensei back on please?
: I’m...ngh...trying, but...Kirin is...aaah! Oh my god! M...Makoto! You should...come play with us too!
: Give...the phone...to Sensei.
: Speaking. Hey, Makoto. When will you be here?
scene makotoiobath31
: I won’t! I want to talk about the hole! I think we should investigate it! When you’re not in the process of blowing the Dorm 10 girls’ backs out!
: I don’t...remember how to get there, though...you’ll have to ask Io.
scene makotoiobath33
: And then what? Have her repeatedly start her sentences over throughout the entire journey there while we do more end-of-the-world troubleshooting? Does that not sound annoying to you?
: Let’s just figure out how to get there on our own. It could mean something.
: Sure...or it could just be a big hole.
: Things like that don’t happen without a reason, Sensei.
: What are you talking about? Things like that happen all the time here. Haven’t you been paying attention?
scene makotoiobath31
: More than you, you stupid...sex guy!
: ...Sex guy?
: Goodbye!
scene black
: Ugh! Can he not hold it in for even a single phone call? We might finally have something to go off of here!
Clutching her phone with enough force to crack the screen, Makoto makes her way back into the dressing room and puts her clothes back on without waiting for the others.
scene tree3
Then she heads back to her room and spends the next few hours taking notes on other things that could be considered anomalies.
Her friends forgetting things that she remembers.
Strange pictures on the walls that she’d never noticed before.
A box in the corner of her room that looks like it twitches, waiting to be filled.
A knock on the door with no one behind it.
The ringing of a phone with no one on the other end.
Laughter from beneath the bed.
As it turns out, she can still feel fear.
It just stems from confusion now.
The kind she can not love, because she can not find the pieces required to solve the puzzle that produces it.
scene black
By the time night falls, her notebook is a mass of black.
She can hear the ocean when she presses her ear against it.
I used to hear the same when I would sleep with my head on your chest.
